name: Campingplatz im Kaunertal
beschreibung: The campsite in the Kaunertal is located at an altitude of around 1,400 metres in the middle of the Kaunergrat Nature Park. Its location near the Kaunertal glacier road makes it a popular starting point for active holidaymakers. The facilities include modern sanitary installations, electricity connections and separate pitches for motorhomes, caravans and tents. In summer, countless hiking and mountain bike tours start directly from the site, while in winter the ski area on the glacier is easily reachable. The quiet, close-to-nature atmosphere and the family-run operation appeal to a broad audience from nature lovers to families. A small shop and a restaurant on site round off the offering for a stay close to nature.
